name: Jonathan N. Schatz
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Chicago, Illinois
education: The Thomas M. Cooley Law School
about: Jonathan N. Schatz is a partner at the firm Allen, Glassman & Schatz, LLC, located in Chicago, Illinois. He focuses his practice on family law and divorce. Serving clients in Chicago and the suburbs, he has been practicing law for more than a decade. He is equally skilled in the financial and family-focused elements of the law. He applies innovative solutions to all family law issues of various complexity.
The types of cases Mr. Schatz handles and has immense experience in include the following:

Mr. Schatz has a successful track record and brings a holistic approach to every legal situation his clients face, whether he is tenaciously defending their rights in court or sealing deals at the negotiating table. His adaptability during both the litigation and negotiation phases of a divorce is attested to by his sensitivity, client-driven approach and knack for effectively addressing complex family matters.

An English major, Mr. Schatz received his Bachelor of Arts degree with a minor in environmental science from the Skidmore College. He was a member of the college’s Campus Environment Committee. He attended the Western Michigan University Cooley Law School to study law and earned his Juris Doctor in 2008. He obtained his license to practice law the same year.

In 2012, Mr. Schatz graduated from the Chicago-Kent College of Law, Illinois Institute of Technology, with a master’s degree in family law. After which, he successfully worked on family law cases at his own law firm before joining Allen, Glassman & Schatz, LLC, in 2022.

Recognized for his noteworthy legal services in his field, Mr. Schatz has been rated “Superb” on Avvo, accompanied by numerous five-star ratings and reviews from his happy clients and endorsements from his peers.
